Definition
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0103 1. Definition 3.28\group harmonic-coordinates

Local coordinates $\{ x^i\} $ are harmonic if each coordinate function is harmonic, equivalently if $g^{jk}\Gamma ^i_{jk}=0$.
